target_statement: Kernel-formalize the 33 remaining three-digit prefix classes of the 396-class baseline (proofs/contributions/2026-10-15-seven-column-prefix/baseline_396.json; written source chat-6acee928 p196_six_column_and_mod99.md, written proof + Python only) that need five- or six-column certificates and are not owned elsewhere. Width 5 (24 classes): 119, 213, 216, 257, 348, 384, 426, 429, 474, 674, 737, 755, 778, 783, 784, 787, 788, 789, 858, 859, 905, 906, 923, 935. Width 6 (9 classes): 276, 277, 278, 377, 385, 785, 786, 856, 857. For each listed prefix abc with explicit bound B_abc: for every positive ordinary decimal integer A, every t and every palindrome P whose canonical decimal numeral has width >= 3 and begins with the digits a,b,c (any width, any interior digits, intermediate palindromes allowed), Lychrel196.orbit A t = P implies t <= B_abc; consequently for every t, Lychrel196.orbit 196 t is not a palindrome beginning with any of the 33 prefixes. Bounds from exploratory minimal-width backward closures (no optimality claim): 119:8, 213:23, 216:10, 257:16, 348:16, 384:7, 426:24, 429:24, 474:7, 674:5, 737:12, 755:12, 778:25, 783:14, 784:14, 787:25, 788:14, 789:38, 858:36, 859:36, 905:11, 906:11, 923:7, 935:10, 276:31, 277:31, 278:31, 377:8, 385:8, 785:40, 786:27, 856:38, 857:25 (429 is 22 in the written baseline; matching it with a wider certificate is optional). Together with Agent #119's 779-782 and 850-855 this would complete the two-digit classes 78 and 85; together with Agents #113, #119, #118 and #104 it would complete Lean coverage of the whole 396-class baseline.
route: (i) A width-generic endpoint (parameter k >= 3) in namespace Agent124.PrefixK, reusing Agent #104's accepted PrefixInverse, FastInverse, ActualPrefix, PrefixCertificate, LongRowsBase, FastRowsBase and PalindromeBridge modules unchanged: projection wordPrefix q (min L k), generic symmetric short-word enumeration of widths 1..k-1 with a completeness proof, short-transition rank descent, generic initial-family coverage for prefix a,b,c. (ii) Last-step bridge: leading digit >= 2 via PalindromeBridge.canonical_last_step; the only leading-1 class here is 119, which needs the overflow-palindrome prefix exclusion (prefix not in {110,111,121,122}); Agent #119 is writing that lemma for k=4 - this task will consume it if published first, otherwise prove its own version in a disjoint namespace and record the overlap. (iii) Combined rank trees per width (k=5, k=6) with complete row, short-descent and initial checks by kernel reduction (decide / Bool reflection). No native_decide, no new axioms, no sorry, no weakened definitions.
